_comment: Flat MILP AllGather on mini_2gpu_2nic with switch copy. 4 hosts x 2 GPUs, each GPU with its own 100Gbps NIC (2 uplinks per host), 2 leaves / 2 spines. Flat solve; the hierarchical partners are mini_2gpu_2nic_hier_allgather_milp_{cell,holder}.json. switch_copy true: every switch may copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port. Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK epoch; objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first. Output: Schedules/<name>.json. See teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
